# Brand Identity

Design a brand identity as one system: logo, typography and colour palette built together from one brief, measured for contrast, colour blindness, glyph coverage, font licences and small-size logo rendering, compared side by side as identity cards, previewed on your own site, then handed over as a brand guidelines kit (PDF, logo files, design tokens) for the set you pick.
